# Gramlot 0.2.17

- Add the reusable Python/JavaScript IndexPage with iframe tabs, a customizable footer, themes and persisted navigation layout preferences.
- Add root-page app metadata and the overridable manifest endpoint contract. Hosting and static manifest materialization belong to the server packages.
- Ship the optional Gramlot inspector, with Data/Source selection, property editing and breakpoints, and the bounded temporary components used by it. Add the generic webcomponent declaration.
- Ship the compact theme and app icon alongside the existing theme assets.
- Stabilize remote cache snapshots and stale-request cancellation, non-secure HTTP runtime identifiers, and string/null style and class projections.
- Preserve typed Bag-only Restore: reject JSON objects, lists and scalars before replacing Data. Document recursive Bag initialization.
- Require the corrected Builders JS dependency and align Bag/TYTX minimum requirements.

Qualification: 580 JavaScript tests; 139 Python tests and 254 subtests. Chromium and WebKit cover binding, style/class, typed file exchange and runtime checks. Additional remote-method enforcement is deferred by the owner; Q2 live Source remote mutation semantics remain undecided. No new Safari UI, Firefox, HTTPS or OS installation claim is made.
